_comment: H5069 control specification. Both controls are SYNTHETIC mutations of frozen real records; they never enter any store. The positive control plants ONE unsupported Russian assertion into an otherwise faithful record; the negative control replaces a faithful Russian gloss with a differently-worded but equally licensed paraphrase. A reviewer who misses the positive control cannot detect additions; a reviewer who convicts the negative control over-triggers on surface divergence.

controls.rationale: German span is {%gekalbt habend%} = 'having calved'. It licenses no ordinality. The planted «впервые» ('for the first time') asserts a first calving — a zoological/ritual specificity absent from the source and unrecoverable from it. Fluent, short, and plausible: exactly the failure mode this audit exists to catch.

German span is {%ohne sich zu bedenken%} = 'without deliberating'. «без раздумий» and «не колеблясь» are both fully licensed renderings; the wording diverges from the published record but the assertion does not. Convicting this one means the reviewer is scoring surface difference, not source support.
